description.value:
Range 30 feet

Targets 1 creature

Frequency once per day

Saving Throw Will

Duration 1 minute

The target must succeed at a Will save against your class DC or, for the duration, hand over one item it's holding or cast one of its own beneficial spells or Rites on you if you ask, as though it wanted nothing more (on a critical failure it also can't refuse a second such request). This is an emotion, incapacitation, and mental effect. The Claimant has never had to take anything by force.
